description: Lists the outputs of one analysis with their status and available formats: first the main report (type `main_report`, id `step:<run_id>:<step_key>`, format md), which every finished analysis includes without buying anything extra, then the reports, codebook, evidence matrix and other deliverables. Requires sign-in (OAuth or an API key) with the runs:read scope. Use it after qualitative_get_run shows deliverables as ready, then fetch the content with qualitative_get_deliverable. It does not return file content. An empty list means nothing is finished yet: keep polling qualitative_get_run.

run_id.description: The analysis id (`run_id`) from qualitative_list_runs or qualitative_start_analysis.

name: qualitative_list_deliverables
title: List analysis deliverables
